d:
I've been waiting years for Lenovo to put an OLED display on the Y700, and the Y700 Infinite finally delivers... but after using it, I have mixed feelings. With flagship performance, a gorgeous 8.4-inch 165Hz OLED display, 5G connectivity and a huge accessory ecosystem, this is an incredibly capable compact tablet — but Lenovo has made a few choices that stop it from being the obvious best in its class.
